name: localstripe
description: A local Stripe-like payment mock/emulator for development and automated testing. Does not process real payments.

scripts.db:test:up: docker run -d --rm --name localstripe-test-db -e POSTGRES_USER=localstripe -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=localstripe -e POSTGRES_DB=localstripe_test -p 55432:5432 postgres:16-alpine
scripts.e2e:up: docker compose --env-file tests/e2e/e2e.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml up -d --build --wait
scripts.e2e:down: docker compose --env-file tests/e2e/e2e.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml down -v
scripts.e2e:logs: docker compose --env-file tests/e2e/e2e.env -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.e2e.yml logs
